text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
U-um, Urara... About those cookies I
promised
you today...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Oh, are they done already? Can I have
one now?!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
N-no! You can't! I accidentally mixed up
the sugar
and the salt when making
them...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, I know you were really looking
forward
to those cookies... I'm the worst
friend ever...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Wait, salty cookies?! That sounds great!
I wanna
eat 'em!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh?! B-but they won't be sweet at all.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
But salty snacks after exercising are the
best! I'm
sure your cookies will be good
too!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I'll come by to pick 'em up later, okay?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Really... Thank you so, so much...
